# cursor_team_member (Data Source)

Looks up one Cursor team member and their current spending-limit state by email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_team_member" "developer" {
  email = "developer@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Exact team-member email address.

### Read-Only

- `effective_per_user_limit_dollars` (Number) Effective per-user limit after Cursor combines team, group, and user settings.
- `is_removed` (Boolean) Whether Cursor marks the member as removed.
- `monthly_spending_limit_dollars` (Number) Explicit monthly user limit, or null when the member has no override.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `overall_spend_cents` (Number) Total spend in cents for the current billing cycle, including included usage.
- `role` (String) Role within the team.
- `spend_cents` (Number) On-demand spend in cents for the current billing cycle.
- `user_id` (String) Cursor public user ID, suitable for organization-group memberships.
